mainEntity.name: What is Mason Nguyen's area of expertise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mason Nguyen specializes in geospatial analysis, GIS consulting, spatial data science, and remote sensing. He helps organizations use geographic data to make better strategic decisions — from site selection to environmental monitoring to custom GIS pipeline development.

mainEntity.name: What GIS software does Mason Nguyen work with?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mason Nguyen works with ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Online, QGIS, Google Earth Engine, PostGIS, and Python geospatial libraries including GeoPandas, Shapely, Rasterio, and Fiona.

mainEntity.name: Where is Mason Nguyen based and does he work globally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mason Nguyen is based in California and takes consulting engagements globally. He is available for project-based and long-term advisory arrangements.

mainEntity.name: What industries does Mason Nguyen serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mason Nguyen serves clients in real estate, environmental consulting, urban planning, logistics, retail, agriculture, and the public sector.

mainEntity.name: How can I hire Mason Nguyen for a geospatial project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact Mason Nguyen at mason@masonnguyengeo.com or visit https://masonnguyengeo.com/contact. He is available for project-based consulting engagements and longer-term advisory arrangements.
